sn2.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || ||
sn2.1:1.3: Atha kho Kassapo devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappam Jetavanam obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || Ekam antam ṭhito kho Kassapo devaputto Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn2.1:1.4: Bhikkhuṃ Bhagavā pakāsesi no ca bhikkhuno anusāsan ti || || 2.
sn2.1:3.3: Atha kho Kassapo devaputto samanuñño me satthāti Bhagavantaṃ vanditvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthev-antaradhāyīti || || 1. Sāvatthiyaṃ ārāme || || 2. Ekam antaṃ
